LESSON: MIRACLES OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Miracles of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Miracles of Jesus Christ
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how they prayed for a sick person. How did the Roman officer demonstrate faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

Teach
• Today’s focus: discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant” using a school example.
• Model B for “discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Miracles of Jesus Christ.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they prayed for a sick person. How did the Roman officer demonstrate faith in God?
